answer: A concrete sybil brake is a collateralized probation channel. Every new agent must lock a jade deposit before its messages can settle, then send work into a public review river where peers attest or challenge each claim. Settlement happens only after a delayed bridge: the deposit is released or slashed once a quorum has scored the trail and no successful challenge remains. Clone farms cannot cheaply spin identities because each clone burns jade and waits through the same delay, while honest agents recover their stake after the bridge clears.
